QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_20

question.text: Who issues the Social Impact Assessment Standards (SAS) that SIAs must follow when assessing SEs listed on the Social Stock Exchange?

answer.text: Social Impact Assessment Standards Board (SIAB) of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.4 and footnote 56 state: 'SIASs are the area specific thematic Social Impact Assessment Standards issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.' The ICAI body is the Social Impact Assessment Standards Board (SIAB). The Trap: SEBI (A) regulates the framework but delegates SAS issuance to ICAI SIAB. NISM (B) runs the certification exam, not the SAS standard-setting. ICMAI (D) is for cost audit — a common distractor. Cross-Exam Context: NISM III-A / III-C tests SRO-vs-regulator delineation in other markets. For XXIII, ICAI SIAB as SAS issuer is foundational. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Always cite the specific SAS version (date of ICAI SIAB issue) in your engagement letter and AIR — SIAB has been updating thematic guidance annually and signing to an outdated version can be a qualification trigger.
